model.name: ONiO.zero CoreMark structural screening model for embsim

calibration.reason: Reported 32 MHz board results for GCC 6b53b974 and 9e3ea11a differ by about 11 percent while the corrected cache model predicts about 0.2 percent for locally reconstructed ELFs; the exact flashed ELFs are not yet archived.
calibration.historical_provenance: The superseded model was ported from rv32sim.py tests/coremark/onio_model.json SHA-256 5fffda831f7fe9dd3054cdbe816c088c21c9c16ea48b12e97bc5e7de9975dfdf; its claimed eight-build dataset was never versioned.
calibration.required_inputs: Exact flashed ELF files and hashes, raw per-run timings, board/silicon revision, clock, voltage, and flash configuration for both revisions.

parameter_status.soft_cycles: The supplied cache description specifies one extra cycle for an other-way hit.
parameter_status.hard_cycles: The value 10 is an uncalibrated placeholder; the supplied cache description does not specify flash line-fill latency.
parameter_status.use: Instruction-level screening only until a versioned board dataset validates ranking on held-out binaries.
